{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast bias when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) — model tends to overestimate prices.",
    "Adjust downward for forecasts that spike above 75.00 — often followed by sharp mean reversion.",
    "Apply a 1-2 day lag correction for forecasts that are consistently 10%+ above true outcome — model overreacts to recent highs.",
    "When sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0), slightly increase forecast volatility to reflect bullish momentum.",
    "For 30-day forecasts, reduce the peak value if the last 3 days show downward trend — model overestimates continuation.",
    "If sentiment is neutral (sentiment = 0) and true outcome is below 65.00, reduce forecast by 2-5% to avoid overconfidence.",
    "Apply a downward bias correction if model forecast is > 70% of 30-day average — indicates overfitting to recent highs."
  ]
}
